contract: FIRMS India harmonized daily active-fire grid
status: v1.3 — h values change on MODIS Terra+Aqua days only (hybrid day-shape; monthly totals unchanged). Layout unchanged.

date_convention.note: For India a UTC day runs 05:30 IST day D to 05:29 IST day D+1: it holds day D's daytime passes and the following night's passes.

tiling.tile_id: {lat0}_{lon0} = integer SW corner in degrees, e.g. 30_74

files.manifest.json: version, scope, date_first/date_last, h_status, h_ratios, tiles[] {tile,file,lat0,lon0,lat1,lon1,records,bytes,gzip_bytes}
files.tiles/{tile_id}.json: sparse cell-day records for one 2x2 degree tile, all dates
files.domain.json: cells inside the data domain, per tile: {version, rule, n_cells, tiles:{tile_id:[local c...]}}

dd.desc: delta-encoded day: day[i] = d0 + sum(dd[0..i]); dd[0] = 0; records sorted by day then c

t.desc: MODIS Terra clean detections in cell-day

a.desc: MODIS Aqua clean detections in cell-day

s.desc: VIIRS S-NPP clean detections in cell-day

n.desc: VIIRS NOAA-20 clean detections in cell-day

h.desc: harmonized metric; null = no satellite coverage that day

mask.desc: mask[i] for day d0+i; bit set = that satellite delivered >=1 raw detection over the India domain that day; 0 = no coverage

regime.desc: regime[i] for day d0+i: which satellites h is based on. 3 viirs = S-NPP or NOAA-20 flew; 2 modis_ta = MODIS (Aqua flew); 1 terra_only = only Terra (before 4 Jul 2002 or Aqua outage), least reliable; 0 none

harmonized_metric.name: h
harmonized_metric.units: S-NPP-VIIRS-equivalent active-fire detections per 0.1-degree cell per UTC day
harmonized_metric.final_definition: S-NPP count if S-NPP flew; else NOAA-20 x k (constant, fit 2018-2026); else MODIS Terra+Aqua x k[2-deg tile, month, day/night] (fit on 2012-2019 overlap, shrunk toward India-wide month x day/night ratio, alpha=200 detections); Terra-only days: Terra -> Terra+Aqua ratios fit 2002-07-04..2006, then the MODIS ratios. Ratios: data/processed/reports/harmonization_ratios.csv v1.3: on MODIS-filled Terra+Aqua days, per 2-degree tile and month the ratio-method total is kept and redistributed across days in proportion to a LightGBM prediction from MODIS fire features (days with ratio-method value 0 stay 0). See METHODS.md.

missing_vs_zero.no_coverage: coverage.mask[day] == 0 (or the day is outside d0..d1): value unknown -> show grey, exclude from medians
missing_vs_zero.observed_zero: coverage.mask[day] != 0 and no record for (cell, day): 0 fires detected
missing_vs_zero.partial: mask lacks the satellites usually present: h is still estimated from what flew; app may flag it
missing_vs_zero.limits: raw data has no swath/cloud information, so per-cell gaps (clouds, between-swath gaps) cannot be distinguished from zero; domain is the FIRMS India country subset, so cells outside India are always empty, not zero
missing_vs_zero.outside_domain: cell not listed in domain.json -> always no data (outside India extent, or never had any detection in 26 years)

tiles.desc: tile_id -> sorted local cell indices (0..399) that are inside the domain
